description: Dry-run a label script's scan station with up to 20 barcodes, in order, carrying kept values (kept.<name>) and the scan count from scan to scan. One line per scan: applied (route, the fields it sets, kept values, copies to print, warnings), rejected (route and message) or unmatched. Saves and prints nothing; free on every plan.

base.description: Field values before any scan (default: the fields' sample values).

clock.description: ISO date-time for today()/now(), e.g. 2026-10-03T14:05:00Z (default: now, UTC).

design.description: A whole design (name, width, height, elements, dataFields, scripts) to run, e.g. the one you just validated. Send this or designId.

designId.description: A saved design to run instead: you see what its reader sees (a linked copy runs its original's published script).

params.description: Form values by param name; omitted params take their defaults. A layout param is { zones: [{ zone, levels: { <level>: "<range spec>" } }] }.

scans.description: The barcodes to scan, in order, as a scanner would type them (e.g. ["PO777", "4006381333931"]).

seed.description: Seed for uid()/uuid(); the same seed gives the same codes.

tables.description: Stand-ins for the spreadsheets the operator would load: table name → rows as { column: value } (at most 200 rows each).
